findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Inspector tested sanitizer spray at 0PPM Cl. PIC was notified and a new bottle of sanitizer was mixed on the spot that tested 150PPM Cl. Ensure that all sanitizers are kept at correct concentrations, tested using sanitizer strips on a regular basis, and remade as needed.

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10).

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-101.11: Inspector observed the mop sink to be sagging down the wall, causing the caulking to separate from the top of the sink. To ensure a smooth and easily cleanable surface, the mop sink must be re-caulked around the top edge. Ensuring the stability of the sink could prevent the need for future repairs.

(A) Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be safe. P Materials used for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES may not allow migration of deleterious substances shall be: (B) Durable, nonabsorbent, and CORROSION-RESISTANT (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness (D) SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, scratching, decomposition, and distortion.
